# ScholrNet — LLM Overview

> ScholrNet is a free academic networking and opportunity-discovery platform for school students in India.
> Students build a single school-verified profile (awards, projects, internships), share a trust-portfolio link
> with colleges/employers, and discover matched opportunities (internships, scholarships, hackathons, clubs).

## Production
- **URL**: https://scholrnet.in
- **Stack**: Python/Flask + Jinja2 + vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (no build step)
- **Hosting**: Vercel free tier (10s function timeout)
- **Database**: Supabase PostgreSQL + file storage
- **Auth**: Flask-Login + bcrypt; optional Firebase Google/GitHub OAuth
- **Email**: Resend (domain verified)
- **Design**: Purple (#6C3BF5) / Teal (#00C4B8) / Coral (#FF6B6B), Inter font, Lucide icons

## Key Constraints
- Mobile-first responsive; no React/Node.js
- All DB counts on landing page are real (never fake)
- No password confirmation on register; no email-verify enforcement
- Free forever; no premium tier

## Key Files
- `backend/app.py` — Flask app factory, 40+ routes, CSP nonce, idle timeout, CSRF
- `backend/models.py` — User, Post, Achievement, Project, School, Opportunity, Club + 23 more
- `backend/models_organization.py` — Organization, OrganizationRegistration, OrganizationMember, OrgAuditLog
- `backend/routes/auth.py` — login, register, password reset, 2FA, Firebase OAuth
- `backend/routes/main.py` — dashboard, profile, blog, landing, schools, admin panel
- `backend/routes/api_organizations.py` — org registration, OTP, admin review, activation, invites
- `backend/routes/api_admin.py` — super admin school/ad/post CRUD, policy management
- `backend/routes/api_posts.py` — posts, comments, likes, achievements, projects, verification
- `backend/routes/api_chat.py` — WebSocket chat via Firebase
- `backend/routes/api_schools.py` — school CRUD, student verification
- `backend/routes/api_clubs.py` — club CRUD, membership
- `backend/routes/api_friends.py` — connections, friend requests
- `backend/routes/api_other.py` — search, notifications, referrals, leads, uploads
- `backend/config.py` — Config class with env var loading
- `backend/extensions.py` — db, bcrypt, login_manager, limiter, compress
- `backend/utils/email.py` — send_email, email_otp_body
- `backend/services/migration.py` — startup migrations, RLS, blog seeding
- `frontend/templates/base.html` — master layout, header/nav, chat drawer, footer, CSP nonce
- `frontend/templates/landing.html` — 10-section marketing page with FAQ Schema.org
- `frontend/templates/auth/login.html`, `register.html` — auth pages
- `frontend/templates/organizations/*.html` — 7 org onboarding templates
- `frontend/templates/admin_panel.html` — super admin dashboard
- `frontend/static/css/landing.css` — design system + landing styles
- `frontend/static/css/style.css` — app styles
- `frontend/static/js/*.js` — main, feed, profile, admin, chat, search, landing

## Routes (Public)
- `/` — landing page
- `/login`, `/register` — auth
- `/register-school`, `/register-institution`, `/register-company` — org onboarding
- `/activate-organization?token=` — account activation
- `/accept-invite?token=&org_id=` — accept member invite
- `/org/<id>/<slug>` — public org profile
- `/school/<id>/<slug>` — public school landing page
- `/opportunity/<id>/<slug>` — public opportunity detail
- `/blog`, `/blog/<slug>` — blog
- `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` — SEO
- `/public` — public timeline

## Routes (Authenticated)
- `/dashboard`, `/profile`, `/opportunities`, `/teams`, `/mentors`
- `/analytics`, `/advisor`, `/search`, `/chat`
- `/school-desk`, `/admin-panel`
- `/organization/dashboard`

## API Endpoints (Key)
- `POST /api/organization/register` — start org registration (rate-limited: 10/15min)
- `POST /api/organization/verify-otp` — verify email OTP (rate-limited: 5/15min)
- `POST /api/organization/resend-otp` — resend OTP (rate-limited: 3/15min)
- `POST /api/organization/activate` — activate org account (rate-limited: 5/15min)
- `POST /api/organization/accept-invite` — accept member invite (rate-limited: 10/15min)
- `POST /api/organization/invite` — send member invite
- `POST /api/organization/settings` — update org settings
- `POST /api/organization/member/<id>/role` — change member role
- `POST /api/organization/member/<id>/remove` — remove member
- `GET /api/organization/profile` — org profile + member list
- `GET /api/organization/audit-logs` — org activity log
- `GET /api/admin/pending-organizations` — pending registrations
- `POST /api/admin/organization/<id>/approve` — approve registration
- `POST /api/admin/organization/<id>/reject` — reject registration
- `POST /api/admin/organization/<id>/suspend` — suspend org
- `GET /api/verification-requests` — school verification queue
- `POST /api/verification-requests/<id>/approve` — approve achievement verification
- `POST /api/admin/school/create` — create school
- `GET /api/referral/generate` — generate referral code
- `POST /api/referral/invite` — send referral invite
- `POST /api/referral/claim` — claim referral badge
- `POST /api/leads` — email capture

## Security
- CSP with per-request nonce (no `unsafe-inline` in script-src)
- Origin/Referer CSRF check on mutating requests
- Idle session timeout (30min)
- Account lockout after 5 failed logins (15min)
- Timing-safe OTP comparison (`hmac.compare_digest`)
- Rate limiting on auth and registration endpoints
- All user content escaped before DOM insertion (`escapeHtml`)
- Plaintext API keys encrypted with Fernet at rest

## DB Models (Key)
- **User**: session_version, login_attempts, locked_until, org_memberships, totp_*, email_*
- **Organization**: type(school/institution/company), status, domain, website_domain, risk_level
- **OrganizationRegistration**: tracks full flow pending_email→pending_approval→approved/rejected
- **OrganizationMember**: role, invite_token, status, organization_id, user_id
- **OrgAuditLog**: action, performed_by, metadata_json
- **School**: name, location, verification_code (old system, not replaced by Organization)
- **Achievement**: title, student_id, verified_by, verified_at, school_id
- **Post, Comment, Like**: social feed
- **Club, ClubMember**: clubs
- **Opportunity**: internships, scholarships, hackathons
- **Mentorship**: mentor relationships
- **Lead**: email capture
- **Referral**: referral tracking
- **BlogPost**: SEO blog content
- **Policies**: terms/privacy versioning
